427-group-footers.text: Switch to multipleColumns to give each grouped field its own column.

426-tree-data.text: Press Expand all, or open one manager at a time with the arrow.

04-selection-copy-paste.text: Drag across cells and press Control C. Paste into a spreadsheet and the rows hold.

144-status-bar.text: Drag across the quarterly numbers. The bar below shows their count, sum and average.
